# BLE and Mesh

## Overview
This wiki page documents the discussions and insights surrounding "[Local-first](./local-first.md) [IoT](./iot.md)," specifically focusing on the tradeoffs between [Bluetooth Low Energy](./bluetooth-low-energy.md) ([BLE](./ble.md)) and [mesh networking](./mesh-networking.md) for consumer gadgets. The topic was presented by Alex Kim ([TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md)) during a lunch-and-learn session at the Aurora office on July 5.

## Key Details
- **Presentation Topic:** Local-first IoT, featuring BLE vs. mesh tradeoffs for consumer gadgets.
- **TeaBuddy v1 Architecture:** The team rejected cloud accounts for version 1, focusing instead on a local-first approach.
- **Demonstration:** Showcased puck buzzers compared against [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) LED patterns.
- **Q&A Highlights:**
  - **Mira:** Noted that mesh complexity is worthwhile when scaling to 6 or more garden [sensors](./sensors.md).
  - **Alex Kim:** Emphasized that tea drinkers generally prefer single-purpose devices ("one device, one job").
  - **Jonah:** Offered to share enclosure supplier contacts.
- **Action Items:** Add a cross-link wiki page for `teabuddy-cross-ref` (noting it may already exist).
